chat.clearMessage: Deletes only your conversation with the assistant. Threads stay.
chat.gone: This conversation no longer exists. Pick another one in the sidebar.

notice.assistant: The assistant sees this ticket and looks up the others you can see. It doesn't create or change anything.
notice.noConsent: AI is off for this organization. An administrator needs to turn it on in Settings. Threads with other people keep working.
notice.noProvider: AI is not configured on this server. You can still open threads with other people.
notice.general: The assistant looks up the tickets in the projects you can see. It doesn't create or change anything.

log.label: Messages
log.empty: No messages yet. Write below to talk to the assistant.

thread.replyPlaceholder: Reply to everyone in the thread, or use @ to open another thread

composer.label: Message
composer.placeholder: Talk to the assistant, use @ to call someone or # to cite a ticket
composer.placeholderThreads: Use @ to open a thread with other people
composer.opensThread: This message opens a thread with {{names}}. Whoever is already in this conversation takes part too.
composer.noMoreLevels: This conversation is at the last level: you cannot open another thread inside it.

add.label: Include people in the thread
add.warning: Whoever joins sees the history of this thread and of the threads inside it.

picker.hintPeople: ↑↓ choose · Enter or Tab confirm · Esc close
picker.hintTickets: Search by key or title · only projects you can see

will.ticketAndThread: Opens the conversation of {{key}} and, inside it, a thread with {{names}}.
will.reference: Stays in this conversation. The assistant reads the cited tickets.
will.referenceThread: Stays in this thread. The cited tickets are only a reference.
will.checkFailed: Couldn't check the cited tickets. Your text is still in the field; try again.

topic.busy: The assistant is still answering the previous topic.
topic.timeout: The assistant did not answer in time. Your text is back in the field.

creation.busy: A new ticket is already being opened: wait for it or cancel before asking for another.
creation.private: Only you see this. The ticket only exists when you press Create.
creation.openedByAssistant: The assistant opened this draft at your request.
creation.newTicketHint: Creates a ticket draft from what you wrote
creation.modeNotice: New ticket: what you write becomes a draft. Only you see it.
creation.pickProjectHint: You create tickets in more than one project. Choose where this draft is born.
creation.projectUnavailable: You cannot create tickets in that project, or it is not available. Choose another.
creation.projectMismatch: This conversation is about a ticket from another project: the draft is born in its project.
creation.changeProjectConfirm: Discards this draft and opens another in the chosen project, with the same request.
creation.noAccess: You cannot see this draft's project.
